title: Speed from force balance
description: Essential: Correctly states the final speed v = U/(dB) by balancing electric and magnetic forces for zero deflection.

title: Specific charge final answer
description: Essential: Correctly states the final specific charge q/m = (U tanθ) / (a d B²).

title: Electric field deflection analysis
description: Important: Applies kinematics to find the vertical displacement in the electric field, relating it to the angle θ and plate length a.

title: Kinematics in electric field
description: Important: Correctly uses the time of flight between the plates and the vertical acceleration (Uq/(dm)) to find the vertical displacement.

title: Combining equations for q/m
description: Important: Eliminates time and vertical displacement to derive the expression for specific charge from v, θ, U, a, d, and B.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Shows that the final expressions for v and q/m have correct SI units (m/s and C/kg).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Misidentifies the direction of electric or magnetic force, or misinterprets the sign of the deflection voltage U.

title: Kinematics misapplication
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly uses constant-acceleration formulas (e.g., wrong time of flight, or confusing vertical/horizontal motion).
